steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: ...It's over.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: 019, 098, stay here to contain the monster and protect ${PlayerName}. Leave the woman to me.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hehe, don't worry. Leave him to me. I will! Aaahhh!
steps.female_content: Hehe, don't worry. Leave her to me. I will—Aaahhh!

steps.content: Bang—

The ground suddenly cracks and monsters of different sizes swarm out. Ignoring you, they're destroying the entire underground experiment area wantonly. One of them lifts up the intruder and returns to above the ground.

steps.speaker: Intruder
steps.content: Amazing. You guys are still alive. I was worried it would hurt you.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: I see... The riot and attacking ${PlayerName} are just diversions. Your real aim is to destroy this place.

steps.speaker: Intruder
steps.content: That's not true. I was dying to see ${PlayerName} and truly hoped the poor Sinners would be set free.

steps.speaker: Intruder
steps.content: I just... didn't expect anyone would stay voluntarily and accept your restraints.
She looks at Hecate.

steps.speaker: Intruder
steps.content: Why didn't you run away when you got the chance?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I don't need freedom.

steps.speaker: Intruder
steps.content: Silly girl... This isn't what a Sinner would say.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: It's over now. You can't resist the Chief's shackles no matter what ability you have.

steps.speaker: Intruder
steps.content: Hmm...

steps.speaker: Intruder
steps.content: Try me.
The ground beneath your feet suddenly collapses. At the intruder's silent order, something wraps around you and shoots upward, the acceleration putting you in a daze momentarily.
Hecate releases the shadow, only to be blocked by the stacks of monsters. You're now left alone with that intruder once again.

steps.speaker: Intruder
steps.content: Well, what are you going to do to me? "The Sinner who dares to attack you."

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, use the shackles!
You grab the intruder's hand. The crimson pattern flows out of your hand once again to bind her body.
The crimson pattern burns that disguise of hers, making her face blurred again.

steps.speaker: Intruder
steps.content: So this is what it's like to be bound by the shackles... You've awakened an incredible power indeed.

steps.speaker: Intruder
steps.content: What a pity... I can't be caught just yet.
She grips your hand and moves it away. The crimson shackles on her shatter at once.
